title: Trail to the Bridge Under Heaven
text: A natural stone bridge formed by two pillars connected by a flat slab 357 m above the abyss - the highest natural bridge on Earth. Width 2 m, thickness 40 m. Reach it from Yuanjiajie loop in 30-40 minutes with photo stops. Walking across is not allowed - view from platform.

title: Loop trail around Zhangjiajie Grand Canyon
text: A 3 km loop taking 1.5-2 hours. Ticket is 118 yuan (without bridge) or 138 yuan with the glass bridge. The route descends via stairs to the canyon floor, follows the river past waterfalls, crosses a lake by boat, then climbs back via escalator or stairs to the glass bridge.

title: Tianmen glass skywalk
text: Not to be confused with the Grand Canyon glass bridge - this is a walkway around Tianmen Mountain at 1,430 m. The glass section is 60 m long with 1.6 m width and 5 cm triple-layer glass. Free shoe covers provided. Part of the A loop ending at Heaven's Gate cave.

title: Ten-Mile Natural Gallery
text: A 5.8 km trail through a gorge of fantastical rock formations, each named: Three Sisters, Turtle, Heavenly Sword, the Elderly Couple. Take the mini-train (38 yuan round trip), walk one way, or hike the full 4-5 hours. The best compromise is train out, walk back.

title: Tianzi Mountain trail - Mountain of the Emperor
text: The northernmost district of the park rises to 1,262 m, with a 5-6 km main trail. Reach it via cable car (7 min, 72 yuan), on foot from Yuanjiajie or by bus plus elevator. Viewpoints: Imperial Brush, Cloud Terrace (fiery sunrises), Western Sea and the Emperor's Garden.
